Dire Dawa · near Aba Tenna Dejazmach Yilma International Airport

A junction town hotel, built for arrivals.

Triangle Hotel sits close to the runway and the old railway line, in the city where the Addis–Djibouti line once met the eastern desert. Simple rooms, a pool to cool off in, and a kitchen that doesn't keep you waiting.

About the hotel

Close to the airport, close to the city

Dire Dawa grew up around its railway station — a crossing point for Oromo, Somali, Harari and Amhara traders long before it was a stop on any map app. Triangle Hotel is a few minutes from the airport gates, in that same practical spirit: a place to land, rest, and get on with why you came.

Rooms are straightforward. The pool and restaurant are open to guests and to the neighborhood. Parking and Wi-Fi are free, and the front desk keeps a phone line open for anyone arriving on a late flight.
